changelog:
* **feat: improve up-to-date update screen** (87a3278)
  - Pin filled Check for update button to bottom-right of the screen.
  - Rename Check again button to Check for update.
  - Drop trailing full stops from the installed version sentence.
  - Show app last update time (Updated on) with 12h time and full date.
  - Track and show last successful manual update check time.
  - Persist last check timestamp in DataStore; only manual checks update it.
  - Add DateTimeFormatter full-date and 12h-time helpers with tests.
* **style: reduce settings card size** (055f3bc)
  - Reduce card inner padding to 12dp and row padding to 6dp.
  - Shrink icon badges to 36dp and icons to 20dp.
  - Tighten title spacers and icon-to-text gaps.
* **style: improve settings card visibility** (e830502)
  - Use solid surfaceVariant/errorContainer colors for settings cards.
  - Add 1dp elevation and outline border to distinguish cards from background.
* **style: clarify Miscellaneous card subtitle** (867a712)
  - Change Miscellaneous card subtitle to "Extra features & data tools".
* **style: use Person icon on Author card** (1bae6aa)
  - Replace Info icon with Person icon on the Author card in Settings.
  - Update icon import accordingly.
* **feat: move Backup & Restore into Miscellaneous settings** (5488e31)
  - Remove standalone Backup & Restore card from main Settings screen.
  - Move backup/restore rows, file picker and restore warning dialog into the Miscellaneous detail page.
  - Keep Reset All at the bottom of the Miscellaneous screen.
  - Move status-message toast handling to the detail screen.
